title: carum meoides subsp. heldreichii
intro: Carum meoides subsp. heldreichii, commonly known as Balkan angelica or mountain angelica, is a plant species within the carrot family (Apiaceae) native to the Balkan Peninsula. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to aid in digestion and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Carum meoides subsp. heldreichii include its potential to treat digestive disorders, respiratory problems, and skin conditions, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents such as essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic effects, although further research is necessary to confirm its efficacy and safety as a medicinal agent.
